pk.context: 0.4 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: olive green and orange hard gelatin capsule

tell: Absorption-controlled kinetics stretch this alpha-1 blocker's half-life to 9 to 13 hours, versus 5 to 7 hours for immediate release.

clues.text: Absorption exceeds 90% when fasting, and fasting raises exposure 30% over fed. It is 94% to 99% bound to plasma proteins and mainly cleared by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with under 10% excreted unchanged.
Molecular weight 408.5 for the active moiety. A white crystalline powder that melts with decomposition near 230°C.
Approved under an NDA as 0.4 mg capsules, taken once a day.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to it or any capsule component; headache and dizziness are the most common reactions.
Signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia, but not for the treatment of hypertension.
Blocks alpha 1A adrenoceptors in the prostate, so smooth muscle relaxes and urine flow improves.
The generic name begins with T and has ten letters.
